title: Identify hotspots
description: Learners find the right spots on an image by clicking, tapping or moving a keyboard crosshair. The graded counterpart to an image map.
demoHtml:
<identify-hotspots question="Spot the three hazards" media-title="Workshop floor" alt="A workshop: a workbench with a power tool whose cord trails across the floor on the left, a wall outlet above a puddle in the middle, and a space heater with a paint can next to it on the right." src="https://cdn.hax.cloud/cdn/build/es6/node_modules/@haxtheweb/identify-hotspots/lib/workshop-scene.svg" max-misses="4">
  <input type="checkbox" value="Frayed power cord" data-correct="true" data-x="25.5" data-y="56.4" data-width="11" data-height="12.8">
  <input type="checkbox" value="Water by the outlet" data-correct="true" data-x="43" data-y="69.2" data-width="22" data-height="17.6">
  <input type="checkbox" value="Paint can beside the heater" data-correct="true" data-x="79.5" data-y="62.4" data-width="12" data-height="16">
  <input type="checkbox" value="Workbench" data-x="5" data-y="44" data-width="38" data-height="11">
  <input type="checkbox" value="Wall chart" data-x="65.5" data-y="24" data-width="15" data-height="16">
</identify-hotspots>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Address of the image learners search

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: Text alternative of the image; never shown as its title

attributes.name: max-misses
attributes.description: Misses allowed before the attempt ends; 0 means unlimited

gizmo.title: Identify hotspots
gizmo.description: Learners find the right spots on an image by clicking, tapping or moving a keyboard crosshair. The graded counterpart to an image map.

configure.title: Alternative text
configure.description: Describes the picture for people who cannot see it. It is never shown as the title.

configure.title: Title
configure.description: A short visible title shown above the picture.

configure.title: Question
configure.description: What learners are asked to find in the picture.

configure.title: Answers
configure.description: Each answer is a named oval on the picture. Position and size are percentages of the picture, measured from its top left corner. While editing, every answer is outlined on the picture.

properties.title: Name
properties.description: Announced when a learner finds or selects this area.

properties.title: Hotspot to find
properties.description: On: learners must find this area. Off: a named decoy that counts as a miss.

advanced.title: Attempts
advanced.description: How many times a learner can try. 0 means unlimited.

advanced.title: Misses allowed
advanced.description: How many misses end an attempt. 0 means unlimited, and learners get a Finish button.

advanced.title: Collapsible
advanced.description: Show this question as a row that opens and closes. Opening one closes the other collapsible questions beside it.

advanced.title: Start collapsed
advanced.description: When collapsible, start as a closed row that shows only the question and its status.

advanced.title: Grading format
advanced.description: OER Schema: grading format for this assessment (e.g. points, letter, percent, completion).

advanced.title: Learning objective
advanced.description: OER Schema: learning objective associated with this assessment.

developer.title: Name of the quiz
developer.description: Quiz name passed in for use in xAPI driven environments for identification of this item

developer.title: Course
developer.description: OER Schema: course this assessment is intended for.
